prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1497
Claimant:
Matthew Reed
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
May 3, 2025
Claim opened after the insured's policy-named driver reported a sidewsipe during a lane change on a multi-lane road.
The claimant, who is not represented by counsel, was identified as a passenger in the vehicle at the time.
May 6, 2025
Police report and two independent witnesses place the claimant in the vehicle at the moment of impact. The other
driver's account matches the claimant's description of how the collision happened.
May 19, 2025
Photos from the scene were received and show contact damage on the passenger side that lines up with the reported
impact point. No prior damage to the vehicle appears in our records or the photos.
May 31, 2025
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage pattern is consistent with a sideswipe at the reported angle and speed,
and nothing suggests the damage predtaes the start of coverage.
June 7, 2025
Claimant reported neck and back strain and was seen at an urgent care clinic the same day. Clinic notes describe
pain and stiffness that fit the mechanism of this type of collision.
June 23, 2025
Medical records show no earlier injury to the neck or back. Claimant has not reported prior treatment to those areas,
and nothing in the file contradicts that.
August 24, 2025
Claimant gave a follow-up statement adding a few minor details, such as the exact lane positions and the sound of
contact. The core account of the event has not changed from the first report.
September 5, 2025
Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and home exercises. Pain reports have gradually decreased
over the past several weeks as the claimant improved.
September 18, 2025
Treating provider's notes show steady progress with fewer visits needed as range of motion returned. Symptoms are
consistent with the expected recovery timeline for soft tissue strain.
October 12, 2025
Reviewed the full file with the witness statements, scene photos, and police report. All sources agree on how the
accident happened and on the claimant's presence in the vehicle.
October 17, 2025
Injury evaluation reviewed. The reported injury is plausible for a crash of this kind and the treatment is reasonable for
the diagnosis.
November 29, 2025
Claim is ready for settlement review. Recommend the file proceed to evaluation of medical costs and vehicle repair
estimate with no coverage issues identified.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
